title: Transit pass
rule: No forest produce may be removed from any forest area, woodlot, private land or other place without a transit pass.
points: Covers trees, timber, logs, poles, charcoal, firewood, gums, fibres and similar.
A forestry officer issues the pass after checking the produce's genuine origin.
Produce with a pass must be marked under reg 7.
A transporter must not accept produce without a valid pass.
No pass is needed for charcoal, firewood, gums, fibres or flosses moved within the same district.
Registered marks are not needed on head-loaded charcoal or firewood, or produce that cannot be marked.
penalty: Liable to a penalty under the Act.
